text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    concurrency:
      group: release
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Elixir
        uses: actions/setup-elixir@v3
        with:
          elixir-version: '1.15'   # adjust to your project's Elixir version
          otp-version: '26.2'      # adjust to your project's OTP version

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mix deps.get

      - name: Run tests
        run: mix test

      - name: Run mix quality
        run: mix quality

      - name: Release with release-please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: simple
          path: .
          target-branch: main
          config-file: .github/release-please-config.json
```
